result:
`deleteSessionsOlderThan` now runs through `TransactionRunner` instead of `messageRepository.manager.transaction`. I did not run tests, lint, or the app.

- **`chat-hub.service.ts`**: I injected `TransactionRunner` into the constructor as `txRunner`. The method now calls `txRunner.run({}, async (ctx) => …)` and passes that `ctx` to every call below it.
- **`chat-session.repository.ts`**: `getIdsByOwnerLastMessageBefore` and `deleteManyByOwnerAndIds` now take an `OperationContext` instead of an `EntityManager`. They get their manager from `this.managerFor(ctx)`.
- **`chat-message.repository.ts`**: I added `getManyBySessionIdInContext(sessionId, ctx)`. It is a context-aware copy of the existing session lookup.
- **`chat-hub.attachment.service.ts`**: I added `deleteAllBySessionIds(sessionIds, ctx)`. It uses the new message lookup. The service no longer needs an `EntityManager` for this path.

The new repository methods still sit on classes that extend `BaseRepository`, because the existing repositories do. The rules say not to convert those in an unrelated PR, so I left that alone. I also left the existing `trx?: EntityManager` methods as they are.

The existing `ChatHubService` unit tests may construct the service directly. If so, they need a `TransactionRunner` mock for the new constructor argument.
